angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 915,541 km at 166.05 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.0224 +/- 0.0133 mas (same row, RUWE 1.07): 166.05 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.316 +/- 0.019 solar radii from Tran et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1670 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..225T/abstract): 915,541 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.21 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Tran et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1670 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..225T/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6170 +/- 61 K from Tran et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1670 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..225T/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Tran et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1670 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..225T/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1670.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.282, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1670 (pscomppars): spectral type F7 V, from Tran et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..225T/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1670 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.09 dex, from Tran et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..225T/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1670 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.40046, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1670 (pscomppars): age 2.53 Gyr, from Tran et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..225T/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1670 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 9.2 km/s, from Tran et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..225T/abstract)
